card.name: Capital M starting malignancy or mortality
card.fires_on: The letter M that begins a new heading or list item such as MALIGNANCY, MORTALITY, MDS or Meningococcal. It appears in boxed-warning lists and section headings right after a period, comma or bracketed reference.

modes.label: Warning headings
modes.description: M starting MALIGNANCY, MALIGNANCIES or MORTALITY in an all-caps boxed warning or heading.
modes.example: WARNING: SERIOUS INFECTIONS, MORTALITY,<< M>>ALIGNANCY, MAJOR ADVERSE

modes.label: Other sentence-initial M terms
modes.description: M starting a new sentence or bullet such as Meningococcal or MDS.
